dialogues.jp:
そういえば、先週の日曜日も彼女は体育館の裏
に来ていた。
dialogues.en: Hmm, that girl was behind the gym last Sunday, waasn't she.
dialogues.text: Hmm, that girl was behind the gym last Sunday, waasn't she.

dialogues.jp:
そんなことを思い出して、俺も足を向けてみる
ことにした。
dialogues.en:
With that memory fresh in my mind, my feet started making
their way there as well.
dialogues.text:
With that memory fresh in my mind, my feet started making
their way there as well.

dialogues.jp:
さすがに校門から入らなければ、平気だと、制
服ではなく私服でやってきた。
dialogues.en:
I reached school much cooler than the last time, even though
I was still wearing casual rather than uniform.
dialogues.text:
I reached school much cooler than the last time, even though
I was still wearing casual rather than uniform.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり来てたんだな」
dialogues.en: "You were here, after all."
dialogues.text: "You were here, after all."

dialogues.jp:
この子は、他にすることがないのかと思うくら
い、いつもここにいる気がする。
dialogues.en:
This kid doesn't seem to think of anything else besides this
place.
dialogues.text:
This kid doesn't seem to think of anything else besides this
place.

dialogues.jp: 「月城は、日曜日に遊んだりしないのか？」
dialogues.en: "You don't use Sundays to go and have fun?"
dialogues.text: "You don't use Sundays to go and have fun?"

dialogues.jp:
月城は何かを言いかけて、結局口を閉じてしま
う。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro seemed like she wanted to say something, but
ended up keeping her mouth tightly closed.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro seemed like she wanted to say something, but
ended up keeping her mouth tightly closed.

dialogues.jp:
軽く下唇を噛む表情が見て取れたが、それはす
ぐにやめてしまい、手袋を外す。
dialogues.en:
She was biting her lower lip, and started to remove her
gloves.
dialogues.text:
She was biting her lower lip, and started to remove her
gloves.

dialogues.jp:
人形で話すのだろう。どういう了見かわからな
いが、月城が手袋を外すと人形が喋り始める。
dialogues.en:
I guess I'm talking to the doll again. I still don't really
get it, but whenever she removes her gloves, the doll
speaks.
dialogues.text:
I guess I'm talking to the doll again. I still don't really
get it, but whenever she removes her gloves, the doll
speaks.

dialogues.jp: そういうことらしい。
dialogues.en: That's what it looks like.
dialogues.text: That's what it looks like.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、人形が喋ることがあまり好きでないのか、
そうする前の月城の表情は、なぜかいつも曇っ
て見える。
dialogues.en:
Not that I enjoyed talking to a doll, but her expression
seemed even cloudier than usual today.
dialogues.text:
Not that I enjoyed talking to a doll, but her expression
seemed even cloudier than usual today.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「遊ぶっていっても、することはないもの」
dialogues.en: "There's nowhere, no one and nothing to have fun with."
dialogues.text: "There's nowhere, no one and nothing to have fun with."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「なにもないって……友達とかいないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Nowhere, no one and nothing...? You don't have friends?"
dialogues.text: "Nowhere, no one and nothing...? You don't have friends?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「友達は、──いないよ。アリスの友達は、ボ
　クだけさ」
dialogues.en: "No friends, at all. Alice's friends is made up of just me."
dialogues.text: "No friends, at all. Alice's friends is made up of just me."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「美春とかは？　あいつなら、ちょっと声をか
　ければ、すぐ飛んでくるぞ？　バナナを食わ
　されるかもしれんが」
dialogues.en:
"What about Miharu? As soon as you call her name, she'd come
flying here, wouldn't she? Expecting a banana maybe, but..."
dialogues.text:
"What about Miharu? As soon as you call her name, she'd come
flying here, wouldn't she? Expecting a banana maybe, but..."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「アリスの友達は、──ボクひとりだけだよ」
dialogues.en: "Alice's only friend, --is me."
dialogues.text: "Alice's only friend, --is me."

dialogues.jp:
ボクひとりって……お前はただの人形じゃない
か。
dialogues.en: Only friend... aren't you just a doll.
dialogues.text: Only friend... aren't you just a doll.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、ほら、テレビとか、マンガとか」
dialogues.en: "Then, what about TV, or manga?"
dialogues.text: "Then, what about TV, or manga?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「うちにはテレビは置いてないよ。マンガは読
　まないもの」
dialogues.en: "There's no TV at home. We don't read manga either."
dialogues.text: "There's no TV at home. We don't read manga either."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「もったいないなぁ。嫌いなのか？　うちの音
　夢なんて、やめろっつっても、ずっとテレビ
　見てるぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"There isn't one... you don't like TV? I keep telling Nemu
at home not to watch so much TV, but she never listens..."
dialogues.text:
"There isn't one... you don't like TV? I keep telling Nemu
at home not to watch so much TV, but she never listens..."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「見たことないから」
dialogues.en: "There's nothing to watch."
dialogues.text: "There's nothing to watch."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあさ、これから俺と一緒にどこかに遊び
　に行くってのはどうだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Then, I'd be your playmate for today, somewhere. How about
that?"
dialogues.text:
"Then, I'd be your playmate for today, somewhere. How about
that?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「花のことが心配だから……」
dialogues.en: "But we're worried about the flower..."
dialogues.text: "But we're worried about the flower..."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「おいしいダンゴを食わせるところ、知ってる
　んだけどなぁ」
dialogues.en: "I know a place which serves some amazing dumplings..."
dialogues.text: "I know a place which serves some amazing dumplings..."

dialogues.jp: 月城はそれでも、ふるふると首を横に振った。
dialogues.en: But that wasn't able to convince her, as she shook her head.
dialogues.text: But that wasn't able to convince her, as she shook her head.

dialogues.jp: 彼女は、もぞもぞと手袋をはめ、花に目をやる。
dialogues.en:
She quickly put her gloves back on, and returned to watching
the plant.
dialogues.text:
She quickly put her gloves back on, and returned to watching
the plant.

dialogues.jp: もう、特に話すことはないってヤツか。
dialogues.en: I guess she has nothing else to say...
dialogues.text: I guess she has nothing else to say...

dialogues.jp:
「しかし……、この草えらくひ弱な感じがする
　けど大丈夫なのか？」
dialogues.en:
"But... that plant looks really weak to me... will it be
alright?"
dialogues.text:
"But... that plant looks really weak to me... will it be
alright?"

dialogues.jp: 月城はそう言って、また首を振った。
dialogues.en: She shook her head to emphasize her reply.
dialogues.text: She shook her head to emphasize her reply.

dialogues.jp:
その心配そうな瞳は、ただその草にのみ注がれ
ていた。
dialogues.en: Her concern for the plant was clear in her eyes.
dialogues.text: Her concern for the plant was clear in her eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「そっか、だから、ずっと見ているのか」
dialogues.en: "I see. And so, you're always keeping watch over it."
dialogues.text: "I see. And so, you're always keeping watch over it."

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷く月城。
dialogues.en: Another nod from her.
dialogues.text: Another nod from her.

dialogues.jp: 「──それ、咲くといいな」
dialogues.en: "--It'd be good if it blooms."
dialogues.text: "--It'd be good if it blooms."

dialogues.jp:
なぜ月城がそれを育てているのか、それはなん
ていう植物なのか、まったくわからないけれど、
俺の口からそんな言葉が出たのだった。
dialogues.en:
I didn't know why she was trying to make it grow, or what
kind of plant it was, yet those words just flew out of my
mouth.
dialogues.text:
I didn't know why she was trying to make it grow, or what
kind of plant it was, yet those words just flew out of my
mouth.

dialogues.jp:
なぜだか、俺がここに長くいることは、月城に
とって望ましくない状態なのだろうと思った。
dialogues.en:
For some reason, I started to get the feeling that she
wanted me to leave.
dialogues.text:
For some reason, I started to get the feeling that she
wanted me to leave.

dialogues.jp:
決して、彼女は俺を邪魔だと思っている訳では
ないのだろうけれど、おそらく長い間自分以外
の人間といることに慣れていないのだ。
dialogues.en:
Surely not because she thought I was intefering, but more
likely because she wasn't used to being with others for so
long.
dialogues.text:
Surely not because she thought I was intefering, but more
likely because she wasn't used to being with others for so
long.

dialogues.jp:
人との話し方……、接し方、見ていれば、なん
となくわかる。
dialogues.en:
Talking with people... and connecting with people. Looking
at her, I knew it myself.
dialogues.text:
Talking with people... and connecting with people. Looking
at her, I knew it myself.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、またな」
dialogues.en: "I'd see you later."
dialogues.text: "I'd see you later."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp:
ま、俺の場合は、こうして話をしてくれるのだ
から、きっとまだいい方なのだろう。
dialogues.en:
Well, in my case, the fact that she actually talks to me is
probably a good sign to begin with.
dialogues.text:
Well, in my case, the fact that she actually talks to me is
probably a good sign to begin with.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、その場を離れた。
dialogues.en: I left the place quietly.
dialogues.text: I left the place quietly.

dialogues.jp: ◆それ、咲くといいな◆
dialogues.en: ◆It'd be good if it blooms◆
dialogues.text: ◆It'd be good if it blooms◆

dialogues.jp:
いつも、草の面倒を見ている月城。日曜日にも
遊んだりすることなく、友達と会うこともなく
過ごしているという。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro was caring for the plant, as always. She had
nothing to do on Sundays, and no friends to spend time with.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro was caring for the plant, as always. She had
nothing to do on Sundays, and no friends to spend time with.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、花が咲くことだけを望んでいるという感
じだ。ただ、それだけだ。
dialogues.en:
All she wanted to do, and could do, was wish for and help
the plant bloom.
dialogues.text:
All she wanted to do, and could do, was wish for and help
the plant bloom.

dialogues.jp:
たぶん、月城は人間が嫌いとか、そういうので
はなく、人と触れあうことに慣れていないんだ
と思う。
dialogues.en:
It seems like Tsukishiro doesn't exactly hate people; she
just isn't used to being around them, and talking to them.
dialogues.text:
It seems like Tsukishiro doesn't exactly hate people; she
just isn't used to being around them, and talking to them.

dialogues.jp:
それは、人形を使って喋っているところを見れ
ば、よくわかる。
dialogues.en:
So to facilitate for the times where she needs to, she uses
a doll to talk for her.
dialogues.text:
So to facilitate for the times where she needs to, she uses
a doll to talk for her.

dialogues.jp:
まだ、直接話してくれているぶん、俺はいい方
なのだろう。
dialogues.en:
The fact that she talks to me herself is probably a good
sign for me.
dialogues.text:
The fact that she talks to me herself is probably a good
sign for me.

dialogues.jp:
あまり躍起にならず、彼女のペースに合わせて
仲良くなれればい。そう思った。
dialogues.en:
I desperately wanted to get into her pace, and get closer to
her.
dialogues.text:
I desperately wanted to get into her pace, and get closer to
her.
